verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation:
Tracing the full cable run across pages 14-17:
1. PANELS-TO-DCDB (DC run): Not explicitly shown as a standalone photo section. Page 14 shows cable annotations exiting the panel zone toward the equipment room under the sheet roof, but individual DC cable runs with conduit/clipping from panel MC4 connectors to the DCDB are not separately documented.
2. DCDB-TO-INVERTER-TO-ACDB (page 15 upper): The equipment room shows DCDB, INVERTER, and ACDB labels on the wall with cable connections annotated. The cluster is co-located so the inter-equipment run is short and plausible, though individual cable conduit runs between the three units are not visible as a close-up.
3. ACDB-TO-SOLAR METER (page 15/16): The AC output cable (purple line) is shown exiting the equipment room and running west across the terrace to the plumbing duct (page 14 upper). The run is annotated but the actual cable is partially obscured in the rooftop shot. No conduit is visibly installed yet (pre-installation TSVR).
4. SOLAR METER location (page 17 upper): Annotated as adjacent to the main meter at the car porch. Position documented.
5. AC CABLE TO MAIN PANEL (pages 16-17): The purple AC cable line is annotated dropping down the south side wall (page 16 upper), running along the narrow south alley (page 16 lower), and terminating at the LT panel (page 17). Route is end-to-end documented.
6. EARTHING CABLES (page 15 lower): Three earthing cable runs annotated going east to the garden earth pits. LA, AC earth, and DC earth pit positions all labeled.
No orphan cable ends detected. No unexplained cable size changes noted. However, as a pre-installation TSVR, conduit/clipping is annotated as planned rather than visually confirmed as installed.
verdicts.rationale: The planned cable route is documented end-to-end across pages 14-17 with no orphan ends or inconsistencies. However, as a pre-installation survey, conduit and cable-tie/clipping cannot be verified as installed — they are annotated as planned routes only. The DC panel-to-DCDB run lacks a dedicated close-up photo. A post-installation photo check is recommended to confirm conduit protection on exposed runs (rooftop surface, south alley).
